powers.name: drift-monitor
powers.idea: Hash the effective config at the start of each run and compare it with the hash from the previous run; report a drift when they differ.

powers.name: usage-exporter
powers.what: Uploads run counts to a vendor dashboard
powers.data_needed: uploads run counts to the vendor cloud
powers.idea: Collect per-run counters and send them to an external dashboard for charts.

powers.name: changed-files-list
powers.what: Lists the files a diff touches for a reviewer
powers.idea: Read a unified diff and return the paths it adds or changes so a reviewer can start from the list.
